items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Wasn’t you? Who… maybe it was… maybe it was Brian. ... Or maybe the, the other guy who interviewed… So Metheny… ‘cause I told you I met him when he was about fifteen. Attila… Brian had at the New School? ... Brian Camelio, yeah.

ctx.x: Wasn’t you? Who… maybe it was… maybe it was Brian. A whole bunch of otherwise hip, good jazz… Are you kidding? (laughs)
